_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Snake diad saray {width}×{height} grid.
Sika so kontrolado na snake {player_id}. Say valid moves: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (or w/s/a/d).
Objetivo: mabalo so anggad longest o say anggad tan longest tan matalosan na score (turn limit {max_turns} turns)

game_action.invalid_death: Inatey si Snake {player_id} lapud ag-invalid ya inyalis to.

outcome.survived_win: Akaligtas so manlalaban a {player_id}; amin ya arum et inatey.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Amin ya uleg et inatey a tampol.
outcome.outlived: Say sakey a manlalaban so akaliktar ed amin ni ran arum.
outcome.all_dead: Amin ya uleg et inatey la.
outcome.turn_limit: Akasabi so limitasyon na panag-turn - say sankarakelan ya score et manalo ed tiebreak.
